Ajay Kapoor interview had no transcript. Pages: only Bustem blog posts bylined by Oliver (company SEO voice); dropped the 21-tool listicle (card failed repeatedly), Bustem marketing/solution pages, the about page (third-person bio), Starter Story listicle and off-target search hits. Posts: dropped jokes, lifestyle/travel, crude or culture-war posts, pure hiring ads and announcements, and near-duplicates.
gaps: Apify blocked (403, outstanding invoices), so x-deep.mjs did not run; twitter154 search was down (502), so posts come from discovery's top ~100 plus a twitter154 timeline pull (43 calls, back to 2026-06-04) before the API stopped returning pages. Posts from mid-2024 to mid-2026 outside the top-100 are missing.
Almost no written long-form by him; the 3 essays are Bustem SEO blog posts in company voice.
Video dates come from yt-api relative dates, so they are approximate (year-level).
DTC Podcast Ep 218 features co-founder Jake Lewin too; only Oliver's views should be used.
